doc.preview:
B6 is a high performance Li-ion/LiPo balancer, it has a microprocessor to detect and balance each cell voltage of the 2 to 6 cells in series.

LED indicate the balance state of the battery pack, "FLASH" shows the high voltage cell is discharged till the difference of voltage reaches the lowest level
